answer: At most 2 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a sonnet tag. The fable cap is checked at intake and grove shows the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, since each member consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. Bonded capital sits idle for 6 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
